invariants.rationale: partitionPath is typically required to identify the partition for the update, so it should not be null.
Each file update is identified by fileId, which is expected to be non-null at method entry.
An update operation requires an iterator of records; recordItr must not be null.
partitionPath should not be the empty string, as it denotes a valid partition.
fileId is expected to uniquely identify a file and thus should be a non-empty string.
